lines.t:
A phenomenon where a <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> transforms into a
{{medal}} of a different type.
It happens when you set 3 <c:ffff00>{{medalia}}<c> of the same
color in the <c:ffff00>{{medalia}} slots<c>.

Besides the emblem on its surface, the <c:ffff00>Robattle<c>
<c:ffff00>style<c> and <c:ffff00>{{medaforce}}<c> also change.

Very rarely, some {{medal|pl}} even change <c:ffff00>{{gender}}<c>.
